svg.title: A log of 70,000 entries, as tiles
svg.desc: Level 0: 273 full tiles of 256 leaf hashes, then a partial tile of 112. Level 1: one full tile whose 256 hashes are the roots of level 0 tiles 0 to 255, then a partial tile of 17 covering level 0 tiles 256 to 272. Level 2: a partial tile of width 1, the root of level 1 tile 0. Full tiles never change; the partial tiles on the right edge are rewritten as the log grows. Entry bundles sit beside the level 0 tiles.

text.tspan: tile/entries/<N>: the 256 entries behind level 0 tile N, each with a 2-byte big-endian length
full tiles: written once, cached forever. Partial tiles (amber): the right edge, one per level.
